articles.title: AT&T Expands Fiber Footprint With Lumen Deal And New Subsidiary
articles.mainIdea: AT&T Expands Fiber Footprint With Lumen Deal And New Subsidiary
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: AT&T Expands Fiber Footprint With Lumen Deal And New Subsidiary. AT&T (NYSE:T) is acquiring Lumen Technologies' consumer fiber business for US$5.75b. The deal includes Lumen's fiber network and customer relationships, expanding AT&T's fiber footprint. AT&T plans to place these assets into a new commercial open access fiber subsidiary. The company expects to sell a stake in this new subsidiary to outside investors. For AT&T, fiber sits at the core of its broadband and connectivity business.
